desc: Implement the full solution: BIT with custom comparator (weight desc, then index-list lex asc) + DP for k=0..4 using `prev[i]` from binary search on sorted right endpoints
Handle edge cases: n=1 (return `[0]`), all intervals mutually overlapping (return single max-weight interval), identical right endpoints (sort tie-break by left, verify `prev[i]` correctness)
Stress test with random small inputs (n ≤ 15) against brute-force enumeration of all subsets of size ≤ 4 to validate correctness and tie-breaking
Final review: confirm output is a list of original indices in increasing order, sorted list comparison, and O(n·k·log n) performance
